body:
## What it does

A creator archive rather than a persona: it answers from the essays and interviews Lenny has actually published, so the sourcing is his own work rather than a general impression of him. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @lennysan shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
